memory_candidates.content: In this repo the deployed .claude/context/index.json is reconstructible offline from the source store: it is exactly the union of each ACTIVE extension's agent-system/extensions/<ext>/index-entries.json entries, merged by merge.lua's append_index_entries, which UPSERTS by `path` (replace-in-place, never duplicate-append; last extension processed wins a contested path). Because active extensions currently declare no overlapping paths, a plain `jq -s '{entries: [.[].entries[]]}'` concatenation over the active set is path-set-identical to the deployed index (verified: 187 entries, empty diff). This enables a redeploy-free verification harness: build the shadow index, assemble a shadow tree whose scripts/ parent basename is `.claude` (to satisfy deploy-root-guard.sh), drop the SOURCE-STORE script in, and run it with --index. Valuable because deploy-headless.sh has exactly one sanctioned automated caller (skill-orchestrate Stage MT-3 step 7), so agents editing source-store scripts otherwise have no way to test them. The harness must assert zero duplicate paths, or the concatenation stops being equivalent to a real merge.
